messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on US-WEST dedicated inference pool (pool-id: gw-phx-2). Error spike started ~1769876500, currently ~12% 5xxs and rising. PagerDuty triggered. @oncall-aaron paged.

oncall-aaron: Got it. Investigating now — attaching initial logs. I'll triage and hand off if needed.

julia-se: Observing increased KV cache misses + connection resets to model workers. Could be autoscaler flapping.

emily-cs: Heads up — Phoenix (enterprise) has high traffic in that region. They asked for dedicated routing SLA. We should prepare customer comms if impact confirmed.

sam-ops: I'm seeing repeated SIGPIPE on the grpc proxy around 1769876480. Restarted proxy on two hosts, but 5xxs persisted. Rolling restart of gateway group 3 queued.

ryan-pd: @oncall-aaron please escalate if no resolution in 10m. Creating an incident bridge: https://call.example/bridge/1769876543

oncall-aaron: On the bridge. Quick mitigation: switching affected model route to fallback variant in another AZ. Initiating now (will remove traffic from gw-phx-2).

incident-bot: ACTION: Route change executed at 1769876602. Traffic shifted to fallback model variant (latency +5-10ms expected). Monitoring for error reduction.

julia-se: 5xx rate down to 3% and trending down after route cutover. Good. Need customer impact assessment and targeted comms for Phoenix enterprise accounts.

olivia-csm: Listing impacted Phoenix accounts (from seat map):
- Phoenix Health (acct: PHX-HLTH) — primary contact: tara@phoenixhealth.com, phone +1-415-555-0123 (Tier 1)
- Meridian Logistics (acct: MER-LGS) — primary contact: ops@meridian.com, phone +1-617-555-0456 (Tier 2)
- SolenixRetail (acct: SOL-RTL) — primary contact: infra@solenix.com (API-only)

emily-cs: Recommended comms flow: 1) Internal status page update (SEV2 template). 2) Tailored email to PHX-HLTH + Meredian ops (phone if Tier1) 3) Post update to customer status channel if subscribed.

oncall-aaron: Drafting internal status blurb, please review: `US-WEST dedicated pool (gw-phx-2) experienced elevated 5xx responses impacting a subset of enterprise customers. Traffic was migrated to a fallback pool; error rates decreased. Root cause under investigation; potential gateway process crash. No data exposure. We will provide next update in 30 minutes.`

julia-se: +1 to that. Add note about potential increased latency for affected requests.

olivia-csm: Customer-facing template for PHX-HLTH (short):
```
Subject: Incident impacting Redwood inference in US-West (Phoenix) — [PHX-HLTH]
Hi Tara — we observed elevated errors impacting inference requests routed to your dedicated pool in US-West. We mitigated by shifting traffic to a fallback pool; errors are reduced. You may see a small latency increase. No data was exposed. We will send a follow-up with root cause and timeline.
If you want a phone update, reply or call +1-415-555-0000.
Apologies for the disruption — Olivia (Your CSM)
```

emily-cs: PHX-HLTH draft looks good. I will call Tara once we confirm stable for 15m.

oncall-aaron: Current plan: monitor for 20m. If stable, close incident and publish RCA draft. If error rate >2% recurs, escalate to infra team for deeper memory/GRPC debug and schedule extended maintenance window.

sam-ops: I'll keep rolling restarts queued on the gateway pool; hold on full scale restart until we confirm fallback stability.

incident-bot: NOTE: Status page posted (internal): https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1769876543 — public update pending CSM OK.

olivia-csm: Approved to send PHX-HLTH email and call. I'll coordinate calls to Meridian Ops if error >1.5% persists.

emily-cs: FYI — logging snippet from one of the gateway hosts:
```
ERROR grpc: connection reset by peer (runtime: 0.45s)
stack: /srv/inference/gateway/worker.go:243
```

oncall-aaron: Noted. Thanks all. I'll post a 15m update here. :white_check_mark:
